metadata.method: Serial predict including tokenization, copies, inference and formatting. No HTTP. First use and model load excluded. Exclusive GPU/build lock.
metadata.validation_scope: Synthetic implementation parity, not labeled model quality.

method: CUDA Graph with 28 distinct layer weights per replay, then median of three blocks. Larger than L2. Isolated operations require full-request confirmation.
